title: TWEETEVAL: Unified Benchmark and Comparative Evaluation for Tweet Classification
reasoning: The paper introduces the TWEETEVAL benchmark, which includes tasks that are inherently tied to morals and ethics, such as "hate speech detection" and "offensive language detection". Additionally, one of the sub-tasks for "stance detection" is to determine the stance towards "atheism", which is a topic directly related to faith/religion. Therefore, a component of the benchmark involves evaluating model performance on these specific domains.
